name: SPECTRA-A executable research prototype
status: untrained implementation and arithmetic checks only; not an accuracy or board benchmark
revision_reason: Resolve previously unspecified neck edges, head decoding and numeric primitives before student training. Revision2 records a DDR-backed tile capacity plan and a small integer convolution reference, not an implemented whole-network tiled backend. The first-version package is immutable.

input.constraint: H and W positive multiples of32; floating RGB scaled0..1

backbone.rep: Conv3x3-BN + Conv1x1-BN + identity-BN then one ReLU; stride1 same channels

neck.pyramid: top-down FPN only; no PAN or additional post-fusion convolution
neck.projections: C3,C4,C5 each linear Conv1x1-BN to neck_width
neck.p2_edges: if enabled: lateral=linear Conv1x1-BN(C2->Cp2); top=nearest2(linear Conv1x1-BN(P3->Cp2)); P2=ReLU(lateral+top)

head.p3_to_p5: two separate towers, each two Conv3x3 stride1 padding1-BN-ReLU at64 channels; each linear Conv1x1 output
head.p2: two separate towers, each one Conv3x3 stride1 padding1-BN-ReLU at32 channels; each linear Conv1x1 output
head.raw_output: list of dicts in ascending stride, class_logits[N,C,H,W], distances[N,4,H,W] after ReLU, stride:int
head.decode: grid centers(j+0.5,i+0.5)*stride; ltrb distances*stride; clip coordinates to input width/height; sigmoid class scores
head.invalid_box: zero-width/height boxes retained in raw decode and marked invalid; NMS rejects them
head.postprocess_scope: no recognition-quality visualization of untrained output; NMS/assignment/training harness remain subsequent integration work

precision_primitive.ste: identity gradient inside representable bounds inclusive; zero outside; exponent frozen
precision_primitive.weight_scale: one exponent per output-channel group32; final partial group explicit
precision_primitive.calibration: exhaustive exponent minimization of weighted squared error; exact ties choose larger exponent; training-only data required for scientific use
precision_primitive.integer_reference: int64 emulation asserts int32 accumulator bound before shifting; saturate to declared output range; right-shift ties to even; no narrow int4 reinterpretation of int8

guidance_primitive.loss: weighted BCE of scalar matched concept scores; di normalized detached class-vector difference; ri admitted_score*flip_iou; wi=ri*min(2,1+di)
guidance_primitive.matching_and_class_mapping: requires externally frozen class-compatible one-to-one training-only matches; helper rejects missing or misaligned tensors
guidance_primitive.no_guidance: zero differentiable loss; absent predictions do not create background labels

region_distortion_primitive.target: detached full-precision feature tensor; gradient through quantized feature only
region_distortion_primitive.energy: sum squared values over channels and pixels, not per-region means
region_distortion_primitive.roi_mapping: floor left/top and ceil right/bottom divided by feature stride, then clip; invalid or empty regions excluded and counted
region_distortion_primitive.normalization: weighted error sum divided by weighted target energy plus positive epsilon
region_distortion_primitive.data_scope: caller must supply training-only ground truth; no inference-time GT access

resource_accounting.physical_proxy: Hout*Wout*ceil(Cin/16)*ceil(Cout/32)*K*K for one hypothetical fully parallel engine
resource_accounting.full_frame_schedule: explicit reference liveness including retained skips, both add operands and newly allocated output; must not imply BRAM implementation or observed PyTorch allocator use
resource_accounting.tile_status: explicit DDR-backed per-operation tile byte plan plus small CPU integer convolution equivalence reference; whole-network tiled backend, bankability, DDR service and hardware remain unimplemented/unverified; over-budget full-frame schedule still fails
resource_accounting.external_storage: all full input/intermediate/skip/raw output tensors and compact weights reside in external DDR in the tile capacity plan; transfer counts are ideal materialized lower bounds only

loss_arithmetic: at least FP32 reductions and denominators; preserve FP64 inputs; epsilon must be finite and >= computation dtype normal minimum; reject nonfinite arithmetic/calibration error; no empirical accuracy inferred from synthetic checks
acceptance_this_stage: 12 architecture variants x2 class counts produce expected shapes
eval branch/BN fusion equivalence within explicit numerical tolerance
gradient path finite on synthetic unit fixtures
quantization and integer shift boundary cases
independent arithmetic counts agree with executable graph
explicit tile capacity screen with external DDR costs
small integer convolution spatial/channel tile equality only
